about: Library components that broke the look rule (Justin, 2026-11-26: built on the base component, look set from outside, no palette colours) when the look check began. Each may get better, never worse: `pnpm --filter @layerd/tools run look -- --lower` takes a fixed one off. Nothing is added here without Justin's yes, written in the entry's `yes` with his name and the date. See CODING_STANDARDS.md.
